_readme: SEAM-3-B, as data. THIS FILE IS BYTE-IDENTICAL IN platform-api, oliver-api, LUMEN-API,
arion-api AND the Portal. Do not edit one copy.
WHEN WE CANNOT DECIDE WHAT A BUSINESS BOUGHT:
ALLOW THE FEATURE. REFUSE THE SPEND.
Every suite runs every case below against its own copy of mayUseFeature/maySpend.
Change the rule in one repo and forget the others and the others turn red.
entry     the { active | owned | tier, decided } node from the entitlement payload
min_tier  null, or the floor the caller needs
feature   what mayUseFeature(entry, min_tier) must return
spend     what maySpend(entry, min_tier) must return

cases.why: no payload at all - the seam is down
no payload at all, with a tier floor
UNDECIDED tier - 2026-08-17: never deny, never spend
UNDECIDED tier that would have passed the floor anyway
DECIDED and exactly at the floor
DECIDED and genuinely too low - a resolved no IS a no
DECIDED Lite against a Standard floor
DECIDED, paid, but the Stripe product name carried no tier word
DECIDED with no tier at all - resolved to nothing is still not a no
